Subject: Exec onsite — staggered arrivals and seat-class requests

Team,

We have an executive onsite with Pinebank next Tuesday (11/21). Two execs (Alison Kim and Chris Delgado) will travel on company tickets. High-level requirements:

- Alison: arrives SFO on 11/20 evening (prefer nonstop), requests exit row/extra-leg room or premium economy; vegetarian meal.
- Chris: prefers earlier arrival 11/20 mid-day (will attend afternoon prep); business class if available.
- Ground pickup: car with car seat for light equipment at SFO arrivals 11/20 18:30 and 14:15 respectively (separate cars ok).
- Flexible change window: can accept one free rebook if we adjust flights within 24 hours.

I've attached the Exec_Roster_20281114.pdf with passport details and preferred frequent flyer numbers. We need proposed itineraries and PNRs by EOD tomorrow so Ben can approve any incremental cost. Please include estimated change fees and a single invoice grouped under "Redwood — Pinebank onsite."

Also include the hubspot deal link in the invoice (HS-34827). Let me know if you need any additional approvals before confirming upgrades.

Thanks,
Irene

--
Irene Choi

Hi Irene — thanks for the roster and the details. Attached are two proposed itineraries (proposed_itineraries_TRV-558.pdf) with PNRs and a line-item estimate for upgrades and potential change fees. Quick notes:

- Alison Kim: SFO nonstop options on 11/20 AA 123 (arrive 18:05) premium economy available; estimated upgrade $145. Vegetarian meal requested — noted.
- Chris Delgado: multiple routing options arriving 11/20 between 13:45–15:30; lowest business class availability is on UA 420 (arrive 14:15) — upgrade estimate $720.
- We can hold both itineraries for 24 hours without penalty. If you want mixed cabin (Chris business, Alison premium econ) we can ticket together but they will appear as separate fare classes on the invoice.

Payment and invoicing: we can bill Redwood with a single consolidated invoice. I included a draft invoice number TRV-22091 that references HS-34827.

Let me know which options you want us to ticket and whether to add ground transfers.

Best,

Mike / Irene —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of adjustments before you ticket:

1) Move Chris up if possible — try for any business class that gets him in by 13:00 on 11/20 (we need him for a 14:00 dry run, earlier is better even with connection).
2) For Alison, premium economy is fine, but confirm an aisle seat if possible (she prefers exits but we'd accept bulkhead aisle).
3) Please add discrete rides for both arrivals (no shared car) and include license plate and driver contact on the confirmation.

If the delta for moving Chris to a 12:00–13:00 arrival is > $1,000, hold and flag to me; otherwise proceed. You have approval to book Alison's premium econ when you have confirmation of aisle seat.

Ben
Director, Solutions — Redwood
